meta.source: Computed by npm run build:data from data/safety.json (relief valve figures) and data/computed/water-heater-expansion-tank-size.json with assets/js/formulas.js
meta.notes: Highest normal operating pressure = valve set pressure × Watts' 75% limit. Expansion = AMTROL factor for a 50-gallon tank heated from 40 °F (expansion tank calculator).
